messages.subject: Error in AllelicCrosstalkCalibration
parts:
Hello,

I'm new to aroma.affymetrix and I'm having a problem with the
AllelicCrosstalkCalibration part of the CRMA (v2) vignette. Everything
goes well until I reach the part of

> acc <- AllelicCrosstalkCalibration(cs, model="CRMAv2")
> print(acc)
AllelicCrosstalkCalibration:
Data set: hapmap
Input tags:
User tags: *
Asterisk ('*') tags: ACC,-XY
Output tags: ACC,-XY
Number of files: 26 (1629.23MB)
Platform: Affymetrix
Chip type: Mapping250K_Nsp
Algorithm parameters: (rescaleBy: chr "groups", targetAvg: num [1:2]
2200 2200, subsetToAvg: chr "-XY", mergeShifts: logi TRUE, B: int 1,
flavor: chr "sfit", algorithmParameters:List of 3, ..$ alpha: num
[1:8] 0.1 0.075 0.05 0.03 0.01 0.0025 0.001 0.0001, ..$ q: num 2, ..$
Q: num 98)
Output path: probeData/hapmap,ACC,-XY/Mapping250K_Nsp
Is done: FALSE
RAM: 0.01MB

> process(acc)

I get the following error:

Error in list(`process(acc)` = <environment>,
`process.AllelicCrosstalkCalibration(acc)` = <environment>, :

[2010-06-22 09:32:15] Exception: Could not locate a file for this chip
type: Mapping250K_Nsp
at throw(Exception(...))
at throw.default("Could not locate a file for this chip type: ",
paste(c(chipT
at throw("Could not locate a file for this chip type: ",
paste(c(chipType, tag
at method(static, ...)
at AromaCellSequenceFile$byChipType(chipType, nbrOfCells =
nbrOfCells)
at getSetsOfProbes.AllelicCrosstalkCalibration(this, verbose =
less(verbose, 1
at getSetsOfProbes(this, verbose = less(verbose, 1))
at process.AllelicCrosstalkCalibration(acc)
at process(acc)

The function generates the corresponding output folder, but it doesn't
generate any file inside it.

I hope you can help me out. Thank you,

José

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Error in AllelicCrosstalkCalibration
parts:
Hi,

as explained in the CRMAv2 vignette you need to download several
annotation files in addition to the CDF file. The error is about a
missing Aroma cell sequence file (*.acs), which you can download from:

http://aroma-project.org/chipTypes/Mapping250K_Nsp-and-Mapping250K_Sty

/Henrik
